summary: Short notes the assistant keeps about you between chats: save a fact or preference, search your notes, forget one.

tools.name: tool_mem_save
tools.purpose: Save one short note that outlives the chat

tools.name: tool_mem_search
tools.purpose: Search your notes; an empty query lists the newest

tools.name: tool_mem_forget
tools.purpose: Delete one of your notes by id

params.name: text
params.description: One short fact, preference or instruction (max 500 characters).

params.name: query
params.description: Words to look for; empty lists the newest notes.

params.name: note_id
params.description: Id of the note to delete, as shown by search.

workflow.explanation: Look up saved notes at the start of a conversation.
Save a fact or preference the user stated.
Delete a note that is wrong or no longer wanted.
